item.name: heading
item.label: Order ID
item.help: Same as the CMS panel id. The cart uses this id until checkout.

item.name: cart_key
item.label: Cart key
item.help: Guest cart cookie key. Set by the cart, not edited here.

item.name: cart_active_time
item.label: Cart active
item.help: Last cart add or open by the visitor. A draft cart reserves stock for Cart hold (minutes) after this.

item.name: cart_hold_until
item.label: Cart held until
item.help: Set by the checkout provider while a payment page is open: the draft cart reserves its stock at least until then.

item.name: order_created
item.label: Order created
item.help: When the cart left draft and became an order.

item.name: status
item.label: Status
item.help: Line fulfilment rolled up. Finished is the final state (paid and lines resolved, or set by hand) and cannot be undone. Listed stock is posted then; those lines drop out of inventory.

item.name: payment_status
item.label: Payment
item.help: Money state. Independent of Status. CMS fulfilment emails only when Payment is paid and Status is unfulfilled.

item.name: fulfilment_sent_time
item.label: Fulfilment sent
item.help: When every payable line had a fulfilment request queued.

item.name: tracking_number
item.label: Tracking number
item.help: Set on the order page when the order is set Fulfilled; printed in the dispatch email.

item.name: dispatch_email_time
item.label: Dispatch email sent
item.help: When the dispatch email to the buyer was queued. Empty: not sent.

item.name: stock_posted_time
item.label: Stock posted
item.help: When listed product_item.number was reduced for this finished order. Empty: not posted yet.

item.name: payment_provider
item.label: Payment provider
item.help: Module that took the payment (e.g. stripe).

item.name: payment_ref
item.label: Payment reference
item.help: Provider payment id (Stripe: payment intent pi_…).

item.name: paid_amount
item.label: Paid amount
item.help: Total the provider charged, delivery included, in the order currency.

item.name: refunded_amount
item.label: Refunded amount
item.help: Total refunded so far, as reported by the payment provider (Stripe refund webhook). Empty: no refund.

item.name: payment_note
item.label: Payment note
item.help: Set when the payment did not match the cart (amount, currency, or lines changed after checkout started). Check before fulfilling.
